justification: Changes which council table rules the nightly quote check may prove as the council's words. Fleet run on all unproven shown rules (2026-10-28, old vs new code): 13 become exact (6 Parramatta, 4 Ashfield, Hornsby, City of Sydney, Waverley); each read; 0 others change.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: a wrapped cell or a captioned table is refused again, or a plain line between two rows is copied
falsifiable_check.observed_red: 2026-10-28: on origin/main council_quote_table.py the new tests give 2 failed (wrapped cell, caption).

pre_impl.existing_data: Hornsby re-read 2026-10-28: facade articulation and two setback tables unproven because cells wrap over two printed lines and rules carry a caption line.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: prove_rows assumed every line is a table row and every cell sits on one printed line.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Extends prove_rows/_prove_row in the existing table proof; no new status, table or column.

functions.name: _wrapped_hits
functions.input: one cell's normalised text, the stream, and the page number
functions.output: first line and lines of each place the cell covers consecutive lines of one column exactly
functions.if_none: no match gives an empty list, so the cell is refused as before

values.if_missing: no lines on the page gives no hits and the row stays unproven

break_it.scenario: A wrapped cell joins the next row's first line.
break_it.what_happens: A value could be paired with the wrong row.
break_it.how: The joined lines must equal the cell text exactly and lie within 16pt of each other in one column.

break_it.scenario: A plain half-row between two table rows is copied.
break_it.what_happens: The table would be printed scrambled to visitors.
break_it.how: Plain lines are allowed only before or after the table rows; test added.

break_it.scenario: A cell continues from the bottom of one column to the top of the next.
break_it.what_happens: Text from two columns could be joined into one wrong cell.
break_it.how: Not allowed: same left edge and 16pt gap required, so it stays unproven (Hornsby p57 tables).

post_merge.db_reset: No. Takes effect at the next nightly council_quote --apply --unchecked run.
